title: Software installed and run as a non-privileged user may conduct improper system calls to allocate… (CVE-2026-19199)
description: A vulnerability exists where software running as a non-privileged user can trigger improper system calls to allocate physical memory. Specifically, a 32-bit integer overflow in the kernel mode driver during page-to-byte conversion causes an undersized kernel buffer allocation. This flaw may allow mapping of unallocated or previously allocated physical pages into an attacker-controlled GPU MMU context, potentially exposing sensitive kernel data.
